A first guide to the living colony.
category.infestusfrontier.contact.name: First Contact
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.the_wakin: This guide covers the starting ingredients and how the colony grows only where you choose. Each page names what you need first. Nothing here is required to play. Read a page when you want to know what to do next.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.a_culture: Craft Spore Culture from rotten flesh, a red mushroom and wheat seeds. Use it on exposed ground to start the colony. Craft a copy of this book from a book and one Spore Culture if you lose it.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.living_su: Living Substrate grows from basic to young to mature. It changes only the cells you select. It never spreads on its own, so the colony stays where you put it.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.roo: The colony begins with a single culture.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.liv: Use a Spore Culture on exposed ground.
